title: witsensor
description: `witsensor` connects Pure Data to a WitMotion WT9011DCL-BT50 9-DOF IMU over Bluetooth Low Energy, providing sensor streams and polls such as acceleration, gyroscope, orientation, displacement, speed, and magnetic-field data. Control messages select and connect to a device and configure its output; streamed or polled data appears at the first outlet, while status messages appear at the second.
